role: fingerprint guide predictor E(G) for GEOM-Drugs steering (paper Sec. 3.2, Table 3)

architecture.note: max_len only sets the padded width the head was trained with; the masked mean-pool makes it size-agnostic, and the steering drivers instantiate it with max_len=71 (the generator's capacity).

label: OpenBabel FP2, 1024 bits, bonds re-perceived from 3-D coordinates
objective: BCE with logits; model selection on val Tanimoto (pred>0.5)
paper_discrepancy: The paper says the guide predictor is 'off-the-shelf from TFG-Flow'. The architecture and the FP2 label definition are TFG-Flow's, but these weights were trained by the authors on GEOM-Drugs in the four legs above; TFG-Flow publishes no GEOM-Drugs structure head.
reproduce: torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=3 -m multimfm.geom.train_structure_head --batch_size 256 --lr 1e-3 --lr_schedule cosine --epochs 40 --warmup_steps 500 --init_ckpt <previous leg best.pth>   (needs the train split of data/geom/geom_fp)
